name: Webwood Egg
summary: In Shadowthread Cave, Webwood Eggs lie in brooding nests in Shadowglen. Naturalists seek viable eggs to study the young spiders in secure laboratory conditions.

sections.title: A Contained Specimen
sections.body: Researchers cannot safely tame or subdue a fully grown, venomous Webwood spider alone. Scholars like Gilshalan Windwalker instead collect unhatched eggs from clutches hidden in Shadowthread Cave. An egg can be carried safely, and the spiderlings contained when they hatch, giving naturalists live subjects to study without facing adult spiders’ deadly fangs.

sections.title: Destined for Darnassus
sections.body: Teldrassil’s native wildlife has grown unnaturally aggressive and corrupted, alarming scholars across the boughs. Eggs and gathered venoms secured at Aldrassil are bound for Darnassus. Researchers hope that raising and examining the spiders in controlled settings will reveal more about the dark affliction spreading through the World Tree’s boughs.

faq.answer: Webwood Eggs are found in clutches deep in the tunnels of Shadowthread Cave, in northwestern Shadowglen.
Gilshalan Windwalker, a researcher at Aldrassil, wants the egg for his study of the aggressive arachnids troubling Shadowglen.

faq.q: Why collect an egg instead of capturing a spider?
faq.answer: A mature Webwood spider is dangerous and too massive to capture and contain easily. An unhatched egg can be transported safely and placed in a secure enclosure before it hatches.

faq.q: What happens to the egg after it is collected?
faq.answer: Gilshalan arranges for the egg and extracted spider venoms to be delivered to Darnassus, where scholars can study the creatures away from the dangers of the wild.

angles.text: As a young kaldorei defending Teldrassil’s sacred boughs, securing these eggs helps scholars investigate the unnatural taint spreading through the World Tree’s native wildlife.
As a druid, understanding how tainted Webwood spiders reproduce and behave offers clues to healing Teldrassil’s disrupted natural balance.
